title: Gradient Existence and Energy Finiteness of Local Minimizers in the Wasserstein $L^\infty$ Topology for Binary-Star Systems
summary: In this paper, we refine and complement McCann's results on binary-star systems \cite{McC06}, a compressible fluid model governed by the Euler-Poisson equations. We consider a general form of the equation of state that includes polytropic gaseous stars indexed by $γ$ as a special case.
